titulo: From script to shot list: a list of shots with sound and dialogue
lead: Making a shot list means cutting the written scene into numbered shots, each with a camera, timing and sound. In 2026 sound joined the list: video generators return audio along with the image, so what you hear in each shot is also a directing decision.
objetivo: turn a written scene into a numbered shot list with the size, angle, movement, sound and duration of each shot.

aprende.t: Write the scene in three or four sentences, with a beginning, a turn and an end
Cut the scene into numbered shots with camera and duration
Put each shot's sound on the list: ambience, effect and dialogue
Check the shot list on the page itself before generating

hero_alt: Dark desk seen from above with handwritten shot-list sheets, a pencil, a closed clapperboard and a stopwatch.

secoes.titulo: From the written scene to the shot list
secoes.sub: Six decisions, in this order. Click each one.

nos.detalhe: The scene in three or four sentences: who, where, what happens and how it ends. If you can't write the scene in four sentences, it isn't ready to become shots yet.
Setup, turn and close. In a short scene, the arc fits in seconds: the first shot says where we are, the middle one brings the change, the last one leaves an image that works as a still.
Each shot is a numbered line. One idea per shot: if a shot does two things, it becomes two.
Size and angle (lesson 2) and a single movement (lesson 3). The change in size between neighboring shots is what gives rhythm.
What you hear in the shot: the ambience of the place, the effect of the action and the dialogue, if there is any. Written per shot, it goes into the prompt as a separate sentence.
The duration of each shot. The total has to match the scene's duration; a contemplative shot lasts longer, an action shot lasts less.

secoes.legenda: Order matters: deciding the sound before the timing avoids a shot too short for the dialogue to fit.

secoes.titulo: How to make a shot list, step by step
secoes.sub: The example is the scene that runs through the course: "The first batch".

texto: Write the scene before thinking about the camera. Four sentences are enough: where and when, who and what they do, what changes, how it ends.
Also decide what the audience should feel. In the batch scene, it's the quiet pride of someone who wakes up before the city.

exemplo.texto: 4:50 a.m., a neighborhood bakery still closed. Dona Lia prepares the dough alone. The first batch comes out of the oven. Someone knocks on the iron door and she opens it for the first customer.

texto: The three-act convention gives a guide proportion: a quarter of the scene to set up, half for tension and the turn, a quarter to close.
Opening wide and closing on a strong image gives you a beginning and an end. Paused on the last second, the final frame has to work on its own.

passos.sub: audio now comes along with the picture
texto: As of Oct 2026, the main video generators return audio in the same pass, with ambience, effects and speech. That's why the shot list gained a sound column.
Google's official video prompt guide recommends describing the audio in sentences separate from the image. The shot list's sound column becomes those sentences in course 1.

exemplo.texto: sound: creaking oven, hissing steam. For dialogue, one short line: "Coming!"

texto: Dialogue in a short video is one sentence. The character doesn't explain what they feel: "Coming!" says routine and pride without naming either one.
Silence is sound too. A shot with only the ambience before the line gives it weight. Score, voice and mixing are the subject of course 2.

secoes.sub: A scene of your own, about 20 seconds long. You can start from the assistant's draft, but the final decision is yours.

exercicios.texto: Write the scene in four sentences and break it down into 5 to 8 shots in the template's format: size, angle, one movement, duration and the sound column. Paste it into the "Check your shot list" section and use "Download the file" to save decupagem.txt in your project folder.
exercicios.pronto: the page answers OK: [n] planos com tamanho, ângulo, movimento e som · [s] s for your text, with the total between 16 and 24 s, and decupagem.txt is in the project folder.

exercicios.texto: In your shot list, leave one shot with no dialogue, only ambient sound, right before the shot that has the line. Check again.
exercicios.pronto: the page still answers OK: … and, in your list, the shot before the line shows only ambient sound or effect in the sound column, without the word dialogue.

secoes.sub: Four questions. The explanation shows up after each answer.

perguntas.p: Why does the 2026 shot list have a sound column on every shot?
opcoes: Because the soundtrack has to be chosen before the scene is written.
Because video generators now return the audio together with the image.
Because the generator only accepts a prompt that starts with the sound description.
Because without the sound column the shot durations don't add up.
perguntas.explica: Native audio became the standard in 2026: ambient sound, effects and dialogue come out in the same pass. If the sound comes out together, it has to be decided together, shot by shot. The music track is an editing choice (course 2), not a prerequisite for the scene.

perguntas.p: One shot in your list says "dolly in with zoom in." What does the page answer, and why?
opcoes: It accepts it, because two movements together make the shot more dynamic.
It accepts it, as long as the shot lasts more than five seconds.
It rejects it: each shot calls for a single movement, in one clear direction.
It rejects it, because zoom is not a camera movement and can't appear.
perguntas.explica: One movement per shot: stacking movements makes the camera fight itself and the result comes out unstable. Zoom is a lens movement and is valid on its own; the problem is combining the two.

perguntas.p: Which of these lines has subtext?
opcoes: "Coming!", said with a smile while she looks at the clock.
"I'm proud to open the bakery before everyone else."
"I feel this work gives meaning to my life."
"I love it when the first customer arrives early."
perguntas.explica: Subtext is the feeling underneath an ordinary line. The other three name what the character feels, and the scene loses its tension. The short line also still fits in the shot's time.

perguntas.p: Your scene is 20 s long and the shots add up to 31 s. What do you do first?
opcoes: Change the scene duration to 31 s, without touching the shots.
Delete the sound column to save time on generation.
Swap every shot size for wide shots.
Shorten the action shots and cut whatever repeats another one.
perguntas.explica: The scene duration is a directing decision; the list is what adjusts to it. An action shot holds for less time, and a shot that repeats its neighbor's idea is the first to go.

itens.texto: Four sentences and the audience's emotion. Without that, the shot list has nowhere to go.
Size, angle, a single movement, duration, action and sound. The total gives the scene duration.
Ambient sound, effects and dialogue per shot, because the audio comes out together with the image.
